parameters.query:
-- Every Monday at 6.00. The computer n8n runs on may be asleep then, so
-- the trigger fires every hour, and this lets a run through only when the
-- latest Monday 6.00 has passed since detection last started: signals_run_at,
-- which "Get articles" sets at the start of every run, from the dashboard's
-- "Hae signaalit nyt" and Run now too (before the first such run, the newest
-- signal stands in). Otherwise nothing comes out and the run ends here.
WITH here AS (
    SELECT now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS now
),
slot AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN planned <= now THEN planned ELSE planned - interval '7 days' END AS at
      FROM (SELECT now, date_trunc('week', now) + time '06:00' AS planned FROM here) x
),
last_run AS (
    SELECT (SELECT coalesce((SELECT nullif(value, '')::timestamptz FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'signals_run_at'),
                    (SELECT max(created_at) FROM signals))) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS at
)
SELECT to_char(slot.at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS due_since
  FROM slot, last_run
 WHERE coalesce(last_run.at, '-infinity') < slot.at;

-- The articles of the last signal_window_days that have a summary in
-- Finnish: the news that passed the filter, and the theses an editor asked
-- for. The model reads the summary, so every article is read the same way
-- whatever language it was written in, and the AI's cache answers for an
-- article it has read before. Theses nobody asked for have no summary and are
-- left out, and so is anything without a publication date, because frequency
-- over time needs one. The window is configuration, not a number typed in
-- here. When this month's AI budget is used up, nothing is read
-- (db/init/24-ai-budget.sql).
--
-- It also notes when this run started, signals_run_at, which the Monday
-- schedule checks (see "Due"), so a run missed while the computer slept
-- happens once, later.
WITH started AS (
    INSERT INTO app_settings (key, value, description)
    VALUES ('signals_run_at', now()::text,
            'When signal detection last started: on Mondays, from Run now or from the dashboard. Set by n8n')
    ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET value = EXCLUDED.value, updated_at = now()
)
SELECT i.id AS item_id,
       i.title,
       i.published_at,
       s.text AS body
  FROM items i
  JOIN summaries s ON s.item_id = i.id AND s.language = 'fi'
 WHERE i.status = 'summarised'
   AND i.published_at IS NOT NULL
   AND i.published_at >= now() - make_interval(days => (
         SELECT value::int FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'signal_window_days'))
   AND NOT (SELECT over FROM ai_budget)
 ORDER BY i.published_at DESC;

-- The signal and its article links go in one statement, so the database check
-- that every signal is traceable to an article is satisfied at commit.
-- Re-running on the same day updates the existing signal instead of adding a
-- copy. The period is the window that was analysed, not one article's date.
WITH s AS (
    INSERT INTO signals (topic, kind, reason, period_start, period_end, score, workflow)
    SELECT $1, 'weak_signal', $2,
           (current_date - make_interval(days => (
              SELECT value::int FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'signal_window_days')))::date,
           current_date,
           $3::numeric, 'signal-detection'
    ON CONFLICT (lower(topic), detected_on, kind) DO UPDATE
       SET reason       = EXCLUDED.reason,
           score        = EXCLUDED.score,
           period_start = EXCLUDED.period_start,
           period_end   = EXCLUDED.period_end,
           updated_at   = now()
    RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO signal_items (signal_id, item_id)
SELECT s.id, unnest($4::bigint[]) FROM s
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
